# `images` — `/api/images`

Image generation through an endpoint: any OpenAI-compatible images API.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/images/config`](#get-api-images-config) | Where Design Center's images come from: {source: endpoint\|local, server, model, cpu_mode}. |
| PUT | [`/api/images/config`](#put-api-images-config) | Choose an OpenAI-compatible server and image model, or null for local SD. |
| POST | [`/api/images/edit`](#post-api-images-edit) | Image + prompt to image (Design Center's image-to-image), through the endpoint's /images/edits. |
| POST | [`/api/images/generate`](#post-api-images-generate) | Text to image. |

<a id="get-api-images-config"></a>
### `GET /api/images/config`

Where Design Center's images come from: {source: endpoint|local, server, model, cpu_mode}. `local` means Stable Diffusion on this computer.

- Handler: [`get_config`](../../../backend/routers/images.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `source`, `server` (JSON object with `id`, `name`, `host`, or `null`), `model` (the `model` value of `null`, or `null`), `cpu_mode`

<a id="put-api-images-config"></a>
### `PUT /api/images/config`

Choose an OpenAI-compatible server and image model, or null for local SD.

- Handler: [`put_config`](../../../backend/routers/images.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `ImageConfig`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `server_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `model` | string or null | no |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `source`, `server`, `model`, `cpu_mode`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Image endpoints use the OpenAI images API. Choose a server of type openai-compatible. | `put_config` |
| 400 | Name the image model the server should use | `put_config` |
| 404 | Server not found or disabled | `put_config` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-images-edit"></a>
### `POST /api/images/edit`

Image + prompt to image (Design Center's image-to-image), through the endpoint's /images/edits. Sends the source image to that server.

- Handler: [`edit`](../../../backend/routers/images.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `EditRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | at least 1 characters; at most 4000 characters |
| `width` | integer | no | `1024` | ≥ 64; ≤ 4096 |
| `height` | integer | no | `1024` | ≥ 64; ≤ 4096 |
| `image` | string | yes |  | at least 1 characters |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `images` (empty JSON list), `source`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | The source image isn't valid base64 | `edit` |
| 400 | The source image must be PNG, JPEG or WebP | `edit` |
| 409 | No image endpoint is set. Add an OpenAI-compatible server on the Servers page, then choose it for images there. | `_endpoint` |
| 413 | The source image is larger than 20 MB | `edit` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Can't reach the image endpoint: {type(e).__name__} | `edit` |
| 502 | Couldn't download the generated image: {e} | `_images_from` |
| 502 | The image endpoint returned no images | `_images_from` |
| 502 | {_error_detail(response)} | `_images_from` |
| 504 | The image endpoint took too long to answer | `edit` |

<a id="post-api-images-generate"></a>
### `POST /api/images/generate`

Text to image. Returns {images: [base64 PNG], source: "endpoint"}, the same shape as /api/tools/sd/generate.

- Handler: [`generate`](../../../backend/routers/images.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `GenerateRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | at least 1 characters; at most 4000 characters |
| `width` | integer | no | `1024` | ≥ 64; ≤ 4096 |
| `height` | integer | no | `1024` | ≥ 64; ≤ 4096 |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `images` (empty JSON list), `source`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 409 | No image endpoint is set. Add an OpenAI-compatible server on the Servers page, then choose it for images there. | `_endpoint` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Can't reach the image endpoint: {type(e).__name__} | `generate` |
| 502 | Couldn't download the generated image: {e} | `_images_from` |
| 502 | The image endpoint returned no images | `_images_from` |
| 502 | {_error_detail(response)} | `_images_from` |
| 504 | The image endpoint took too long to answer | `generate` |
